coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult trial (age 3-25 for pHGG, 3-39 for osteosarcoma); glioblastoma is named in the pHGG inclusion criteria, with osteosarcoma as a second tumour type, so coded basket_gbm_eligible (mixed_glioma_gbm_named would also include it). Only interventions are two RNA-LP cancer vaccines (excluded type). Immune activation in blood and tumour is a planned pharmacodynamic outcome for the vaccine. Mismatch repair deficient tumours are an eligible subgroup, not a requirement, so no biomarker row.
